dialog.title: Operation Successful
dialog.description: Your changes have been saved successfully.

dialog.title: Delete Item
dialog.description: Are you sure you want to delete this item? This action cannot be undone.

dialog.title: Select a User
dialog.description: Click on a user to select them.

wide-dialog.title: Wide Dialog
wide-dialog.html-heading: This dialog takes up {{width}} of the viewport width, capped at {{maxWidth}} maximum.

auto-focus-dialog.title: Auto Focus
auto-focus-dialog.description: The dialog header received focus automatically when this dialog opened.

no-focus-trap-dialog.title: No Focus Trap
no-focus-trap-dialog.description: Focus is not trapped. You can Tab outside this dialog.

auto-focus-first-tabbable-dialog.title: Auto Focus First Tabbable
auto-focus-first-tabbable-dialog.description: Focus trap is active. The first tabbable element gets focus.

custom-focus-dialog.title: Custom Focus
custom-focus-dialog.description: Focus trap is active. The "Close" button gets focus.

dialog.title: Loading State
dialog.description: Click "Reload" to simulate an async operation with loading state.

dialog.initial-description: Title and description will update in 2 seconds.
dialog.loaded-description: This title and description were set asynchronously after opening.

delayed-close-dialog.title: onCloseHandler$ Demo
delayed-close-dialog.description: Toggle the close delay to see how setCloseHandler() intercepts close events.

confirm-close.message: Closing this dialog will require confirmation

delayed-close.message: Close delay is active. Clicking "Close" will start a 2-second countdown before the dialog closes.

nested-modal.description: Demonstrates opening a dialog from within another dialog. On mobile, the first dialog fades out while the second fades in.

parent-dialog.title: Parent Dialog
parent-dialog.description: This is the parent dialog. Open a nested dialog from here.
parent-dialog.extra-1: Extra content paragraph one. This makes parent dialog taller and visually distinct from nested dialog.
parent-dialog.extra-2: Extra content paragraph two. You should see this text slide up when the parent opens on mobile.
parent-dialog.extra-3: Extra content paragraph three. More text means more height difference between parent and nested dialog.
parent-dialog.extra-4: Extra content paragraph four. The nested dialog only has one line of description text.

nested-dialog.title: Nested Dialog
nested-dialog.description: This is a nested dialog opened from the parent.

nested-modal-stack.description: The same nested dialog demo, but opened with stackingOnMobile: 'stack'. The nested dialog still fades in, but the first one is left expanded underneath instead of collapsing — so nothing animates out while you go deeper.

nested-modal-none.description: The same nested dialog demo, but opened with stackingOnMobile: 'none'. On mobile both dialogs open and close instantly, and the first one stays in place instead of fading out — compare it with the section above.

drawer-dialog-stacking.description: Opening a dialog on top of an already-open drawer on mobile. Only dialogs take part in the switch animation, so the drawer stays put instead of being faded out.

drawer.title: Drawer
drawer.description: Tap the button below to open a dialog on top of this drawer. On mobile, the drawer should stay in place behind it.

dialog.title: Dialog opened over a drawer
dialog.description: The drawer beneath is left untouched — it is not treated as a crossfade parent.
